paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: Different Audio-Language models’ performance on MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different audio-language models on two benchmarks, MMAU and MMAR, by comparing their accuracy percentages. The horizontal axis lists the model names - Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni - in a fixed order, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, labeled as "Accuracy (%)", ranging from 0 to 70 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. For each model, there are two adjacent bars representing MMAU and MMAR, colored in blue and purple, respectively, as indicated by the legend. The MMAU bars have approximate values of 48, 60, and 64 for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, respectively, while the MMAR bars have approximate values of 30, 35, and 56 for the same models. The bars are grouped by model, with MMAU and MMAR bars placed side by side for each model, and are not sorted in any particular order other than their fixed listing on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
